description: On the table in front of you there’s a white, cup-shaped cover sitting over a small white lamp-like piece mounted on a rectangular base. The left hand stays resting on the table while the right hand reaches in from the right, grips the cup-shaped cover as a right-hand object, lifts it upward off the lamp piece, then carries it left and sets it down on the tabletop, leaving the lamp piece exposed on its base.
